svg.aria-label: Wiring diagram, Headlights · front fog lights (option) · headlight retractor motor (Federal & California)

text.tspan: Factory wiring transcribed from the Mazda workshop manual 1193-10-89C, section Z (North American edition).
Wire drawn in its Mazda colour (stripe = 2nd colour); label = colour (harness: F front, E engine, I instrument panel, R rear …).
Pins are named by Mazda terminal number where printed, otherwise by wire colour as printed in the face view.
Grey boxes '→ X' continue in system X; GND ① … ⑦ are the ground points of section Y.
